digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler differ and mutation filtering
propositions: Raw compute_mutations API must treat its first argument as real local state and emit field_drift for state divergence, serving as a load-bearing positive control.
Production snapshot caller violates the API contract by passing both remote Jira state arguments, requiring call-site suppression of differ-owned emissions (field_drift and unbound_local).
A4-1 implemented the correct suppression filter at the call site to preserve the raw differ contract and allow future migration to real local state.
The call-site filter must not be moved into the differ implementation, as doing so would break the positive control and violate the intentional separation.
Verification confirms the raw differ emits field_drift while the production result contains zero outbound updates for the same entry.
Genuine inbound creates and invariant repairs survive the suppression filter, convergence achieves mutation_count == 0, and production instrumentation confirms zero per-mutation calls.
